swept: hn (48h), reddit rss (r/webdev rate-limited), github, last30days (3d)
dropped: Purge (Mac cleaner): still no price grudge in the README or this week's post; 'no paid version' is a feature bullet. Same call as 2026-09-19
avdslim: strong tool, but the README's motive is emulator RAM, not the cost of Genymotion or anything else
Inkvec: no price grudge, and it is EuroHPC-funded research rather than a grudge build
Fouine: €39 once with a 30-day trial, fails the free gate
Gotedo Impress: free, but you must create a Gotedo Account before you can activate it
SocialClipper: open-core, the builder's own $4.99/mo cloud tier
Reachbeam: free with an optional paid tier
Typoly: 2 free credits then paid
ClearBooks: 'completely free right now', requires real accounts, and the builder says he set out to build something people would pay for
Delve: 'no subscription' in the description but no grudge anywhere in the README. Same call as 2026-09-19
LuminaStudio: 'no subscription lock-in' is a feature bullet, not a stated reason
Ping-Monitor, SoloDev-Studio, memegenscript, YourAi: 'free forever' / 'no subscription' taglines with no grudge behind them
leotabs, outloud, Youtarr, chordscan, Video Size Reducer: free and good, but the builders never mention anyone's price
Timeline: grudge is that Gantt tools are unsatisfying, not that they cost money
Set: grudge is Notion's direction, not Notion's price; still in beta
XConnect: grudge is app switching on a small screen, not Microsoft's RDP pricing
SIM Screener: grudge is Xcode 27's Device Hub, not a price
astra-flash-orchestrator and ccsaver: about spending less inside a plan you still pay for, not replacing it
OneTimePay uptime monitor: a pay-once storefront, the free tier is the hook
Domino for Mac: commenters are asking which features are Pro-only
StemKit note: overlaps Stems (already listed) on the same category but is a different app, different builder, different victim
